blindness: The prediction record does not contain the publication fitted correlation, experimental values, or source result/error discussion. Implementing-agent exposure to the public article is disclosed; no claim of human-custodian isolation is made.
reveal_rule: Only after this manifest and the three listed artifacts are hash-verified may the custodian add the publication-derived correlation and figure/experimental comparison.
post_reveal_mutation_rule: Any changed model, property, geometry, or criterion receives a new POST-REVEAL run ID and never overwrites these files.
